author: kpedro88
body:
This PR attempts to improve a common SCRAM error message.

After the following initialization:
```bash
source /cvmfs/cms.cern.ch/cmsset_default.sh
export SCRAM_ARCH=el9_amd64_gcc12
export SCRAM_LOOKUPDB=/cvmfs/cms.cern.ch
```
(where the last line is just necessary for local testing of this repo)

This command:
```bash
cli/scram project CMSSW CMSSW_17_0_0_pre2
```

now gives the following error message:
```
ERROR: Project "CMSSW" version "CMSSW_17_0_0_pre2" is not available for arch el9_amd64_gcc12.
       "CMSSW" is currently available for following archs.
       Please set SCRAM_ARCH properly and re-run the command.
       bash:
       export SCRAM_ARCH=el9_amd64_gcc13
       export SCRAM_ARCH=el9_amd64_gcc14
       tcsh:
       setenv SCRAM_ARCH el9_amd64_gcc13
       setenv SCRAM_ARCH el9_amd64_gcc14
```

(fully general accurate shell detection in Python is a nightmare, so it just prints both the bash and tcsh versions.)
title: print exact environment setting commands
